If you felt the host was unfair, the appropriate step would’ve been to politely clarify ownership *before* taking it—not to assume. **Key takeaway**: In group settings, shared food belongs to the host until they say otherwise. Always ask before taking anything—not everyone’s expectations are the same, and assuming is what makes you the asshole here. 🍝
